PROVEN.REDUCTION_SYMMETRY: The reduced (4,2) lines (a)-(d) with D1 = {0,1} are invariant under (U+a, V+b, W+a+b) for arbitrary a, b in F2^5 (each line is invariant or its two summands co-translate) and under the mirror U <-> V; therefore the walk normalization 0 in U and 0 in V loses no solutions (every solution orbit contains one). Algebraic co-translation argument; machine-checked on 300 random configurations in test_engine.py (test_residual_symmetry, test_mirror_symmetry).
PROVEN.ENGINE_EQUIVALENCE: walk42.solve_w42 and the hot-path solve_w42_fast equal complete brute force over all C(32,4) W 4-sets on sampled F2^5 pairs and over ALL W subsets at m=3 for all w sizes (test_engine.py: 5 + 30 + 20 sampled pairs); pair_backtrack42 equals brute force over all 169,911 normalized V at needs 24 and 27 on sampled U; the reduced (4,2) lines equal direct A + D coverage in E = F2^4 on EVERY halved configuration in the (1,1),(1,2),(2,1) analogue grid (test_direct_vs_reduced_lines).
